en: the plants there are of every kind:
jicama and eggplant, winged bean and peanut,
yardlong bean, hyacinth bean, lima bean,
Wax gourd, sponge gourd, bottle gourd and squash,
and besides there are still radish, mustard,
All around it is full of sesame.
notes: line 1.1: 'bahay kubo', literally 'cube house', the Filipino stilt hut of bamboo and nipa palm.
line 1.3: singkamas is jicama (yam bean); sigarilyas the winged bean.
line 1.4: sitaw is the yardlong (string) bean; bataw the hyacinth bean (lablab); patani the lima bean.
line 2.1: kundol is the wax (winter) gourd; patola the sponge gourd (luffa); upo the bottle gourd; kalabasa squash or pumpkin.
